:::{#exm-measure-space}
#### Measure space of die rolls

For the die rolls $D = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
adding the counting function $\mu(A) = \abs{A}$ of @exm-measure
to the [measurable space](#def-measurable-space) $(D, \mathscr{S})$ of @exm-measurable-space
makes $(D, \mathscr{S}, \mu)$ a measure space.

:::
